proof_summary: For \(n=716993899\), so \(2n-1=1433987797\), size bounds force any possible exponents to satisfy \(1\le x,y\le30\). Exhausting these pairs shows each candidate \(1433987797-2^x-7\cdot2^y\) is nonpositive, has the wrong residue modulo \(6\), or is composite, while this \(n\) is not among the proposed exceptions.
